title: Places and things you like
questions: Tell me about a place you like.
What do you usually see on the way to that place?
Describe a room where you feel comfortable.
Tell me about a trip you remember well.
What is a park or street near you like?
Describe your favourite season and what you do in it.
Tell me about a building you find interesting.
What would you show a visitor in your town?
Tell me about somewhere you would like to go one day.
